what: Drift baseline seeding on retained Step 2b.5 is only documented for Step 2b validator Override; no script write contract and Gate B Override-after-defects is omitted
scenario_or_breakage: Validator or Gate B Override runs retained Step 2b.5 without a prior successful `--snapshot-original` emit, so `drift-baseline.env` is never created; `check-plan-size.sh` treats absent baseline as no drift and the cumulative guard stays disabled for the rest of the run
suggested_fix: Add one write-on-absent owner: either have `check-plan-size.sh` write `BASELINE_PLAN_LINES`/`BASELINE_DIFF_LINES` once when the file is missing (minimum change), or extend the Step 2b.5 standalone procedure and Gate B Override prose to seed the same keys after every retained caller’s first successful parse; add a harness case for Override-without-snapshot seeding
